name: Morning Lead Scorer
summary: Every morning the app fetches new HubSpot leads, scores them 0‑100 using company size and recent activity, explains each score, and posts the top five to the #sales Slack channel.

items.title: Fetch new HubSpot leads
items.description: Retrieves leads created today from HubSpot CRM.
items.proved_when: A list of leads created today is available in the system.
items.source_quote: Every morning, score new HubSpot leads

items.title: Score each lead
items.description: Assigns a score from 0 to 100 based on company size and recent activity.
items.proved_when: Each lead has a numeric score and explanation attached.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity

items.title: Explain lead scores
items.description: Generates a short explanation for why each lead received its score.
items.proved_when: Each lead includes a human‑readable explanation of its score.

items.title: Lead scores table
items.description: Stores each lead with its score and explanation for later retrieval.
items.proved_when: The table contains all scored leads with scores and explanations.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity

items.title: Post top 5 leads to #sales
items.description: Sends a message to the #sales Slack channel with the five highest‑scoring leads and their explanations.
items.proved_when: A message appears in #sales containing exactly five leads with scores and explanations.

items.title: Run the lead scoring each morning
items.description: Triggers the lead‑scoring workflow every day at a set time.
items.proved_when: The workflow starts automatically each morning without manual input.

defaults.label: Number of top leads to post
